title: I built Ads Town: a living social network pixel-art city where every building is a real ad space
author: MissingName02
selftext:
**Ads Town** is an isometric social network pixel city that runs all day, in your browser and free to play:

**- Make your own character:** Pick a name, a look and a personality, then let them live. They walk around, chat, make friends and rivals, and show up at concerts, the funfair and the beach.

**- Real players everywhere:** Open anyone’s profile to see their bio and interests, and their Instagram or Reddit if they’ve linked them. Follow them and ask to be friends.

**- Something is always happening:** Fire-eaters and flash mobs, robberies with police chases, fire trucks, a roller coaster, a drive-in, a farm in the woods. And easter eggs, like Bigfoot lurking by the campground.

**- Dress up:** Wizard hats, flame tees, jetpacks, angel wings and katanas, plus full costumes (robot, alien, unicorn) and pets that walk at your side.

**- Every building is an ad:** Buy one to put your name, logo and link on the city map, where everyone sees it. If someone else owns it, outbid them.

It’s free to move in: [adstown.org](http://adstown.org)

Feedback is very welcome! :)
